sloka: स निकुम्भं च कुम्भं च कुम्भकर्णात्मजावुभौ।प्रेषयामास सङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसैर्बहुभिः सह ।। ६.७५.४५ ।।
transliteration: sa nikumbhaṁ ca kumbhaṁ ca kumbhakarṇātmajāvubhau।preṣayāmāsa saṅkruddho rākṣasairbahubhiḥ saha ।। 6.75.45 ।।

translations.english: Holding burning torches in hand the Vanara chiefs reached and standing at the gate, saw that Ravana was overtaken by anger.
